strengths.text: Tổ máy diesel 9–3450 kVA; làm cả tháp đèn di động và trạm phát chạy liên tục
Có giải pháp nguồn liên tục / dự phòng 10–3000 kVA cho mỏ dầu
Theo hãng: là một trong các nhà sản xuất hàng đầu Trung Quốc

quote: Copyright © 2023, Shandong Penlucky Power Equipment Co., Ltd. All rights reserved.
1-1-917, Danguili Golden Street, Dongfeng Street, Kuiwen District, Weifang City, Shandong Province, China
We provide comprehensive solution for prime/standby power generation from 10-3000kva on oil field.

Established in 2007, Penlucky today is one of the Chinese leading manufacturers of the highest quality diesel generating sets and complete power generation systems. We have a wide power range from 9kVA to 3450kVA with world famous engine and alternator brand.

Penlucky Power is located in Weifang High-Tech Zone, Shandong, China, founded in 2007, specializing in the design, manufacture, and sales of mobile lighting towers, standby generator sets, and continuous operation power stations.
